title: Funk
tagline: Interlocking grooves where the rhythm section leads the way.
summary: Funk places the groove at the center of a song. Repeating bass lines, clipped guitar parts, syncopated drums, and expressive horns work together to create a strong rhythmic pocket. Emerging from soul and rhythm and blues, funk influenced dance music, hip-hop sampling, and generations of musicians who treat rhythm as the main event.

pillars.name: James Brown
pillars.why: James Brown's rhythm-first arrangements made the downbeat and the band’s interlocking parts central to funk.

pillars.name: Parliament-Funkadelic
pillars.why: Parliament-Funkadelic stretched funk into an expansive world of deep grooves, group vocals, and playful production.

pillars.name: Sly and the Family Stone
pillars.why: Sly and the Family Stone brought a distinctive blend of funk, soul, and rock to a multivocal band sound.
